rows.notes: The document is the FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 Rev.1, a guideline/field guide synthesising published data and experiences (guidelines, crop tolerance tables adapted from Maas and Hoffman, case summaries citing other sources). It is not a primary study. Section 7 states that subsurface tile or trickle irrigation systems create the fewest hazards of microbial contamination of air, soil and plants when applying effluent, while sprinklers create the greatest potential for contamination, but this is an expert statement without any original data on drip and microbial contamination. Q1 is 'no', so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.
